statement: For accepted nominalQ,pi on actualGamma andA_B={|x|1<=B}, keepinteriorrates, setQ_B(x,star)=sum_(z outside)Q(x,z) andQ_B(star,x)=sum_(z outside)pi(z)Q(z,x)/pi(outside).
